student_role_scope: Agent role exercises, including revisions after failed attempts. Not measured human workload.

team_identity_scope: Self-registered team access. Possession of the agreed shared password is not verification of GitHub membership or university identity.
preview_scope: Optional own-plan CPU geometry and actual recorded Genesis robot/cup/bead playback. Read-only export does not rerun physics or create a validation certificate.
scope: Student workspace and English guidance for the activated term_v3 bead competition. Protected physics, source and rule hashes match retained current-PC native evidence. GTX1660 SUPER performance remains unmeasured. No reference solution is included.
release_authorization_scope: Instructor explicitly requested student distribution and official activation on 2026-11-14. Current-PC native evidence retained. GTX1660 SUPER qualification is still pending.
safe_supplied_file_updates: check/apply/status/rollback with official release hashes, backups and preservation of student work
student_repository_visibility: one private shared repository per team
contribution_evidence: Each member uses their own account to commit and push. Present their actual contribution using the shared repository history.
public_leaderboard_privacy: Results only. Other teams cannot access design inputs, joint paths, full receipts or diagnostics.

optional_visual_export.inside_view: Transparent cup, follow camera and cup-only interior view
optional_visual_export.verification_limit: Recorded-data conversion, component rendering and recording lifecycle tested. Real browser video download remains unverified.

compact_design_inputs.scope: Input adapter and visualization change. Protected physics/source and rules unchanged. New supplied parking has CPU path validation. Existing full-transport evidence does not establish a repeated full-native matrix for these new parking values.

student_naming.solo: Own student ID for the private repository and leaderboard name
student_naming.group: All member IDs sorted ascending and joined with hyphens for one shared private repository and leaderboard name
